en: The image shows a multi-story modernist building, likely an apartment or hotel, with wide balconies and large glass windows. The building is set among lush green trees, and there are people walking on a path in the foreground. A classic car, possibly from the 1960s or 1970s, is parked near the entrance. The postcard has a bright, somewhat faded color palette typical of mid-20th century prints. There is no visible text on the postcard.
